sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: ONE-GO Gq BRET assay: receptor is surface-expressed and functionally active in Gq-coupled signaling; FLAG-tagged construct used as the wild-type reference in the assay.
sites.rationale: Both L1 and L2 report N-terminal FLAG tags on the full-length, membrane-anchored B1R; L2 is chosen as the primary clip because it explicitly confirms surface expression and functional Gq signaling via BRET. The extracellular N-terminus (residues 1–38) is the only extracellular terminus (the C-terminus, residues 316–353, is intracellular), so insert_after_residue=0 is the unique topology-derived junction. Python confirms residue 1 is M and TM1 begins at residue 39, placing the tag 38 residues from the TM boundary, well above the ≥3-residue minimum. No residue number is named in either paper, so position_evidence is topology_derived. Full-length human B1R (residues 1–353) cloned into pcDNA3.1(+) with an exogenous HA signal peptide followed by an N-terminal FLAG tag; construct used in a ONE-GO Gq BRET assay for functional surface expression. Neither L2 nor L1 names a specific residue number; the N-terminus (residues 1–38, extracellular per landmarks) is the sole extracellular terminus of this GPCR, so the junction is topology-derived as a prepend before M1. BDKRB1 (P46663) carries no native signal peptide, so the exogenous HA-SP is cleaved and the FLAG tag is left at the mature extracellular N-terminus.

sources.claim: For both the wild-type B1R and B2R constructs used in ONE-GO Gq BRET assay, a full-length human receptor gene (residues 1–353 for B1R or residues 1–391 for B2R) was cloned into a pcDNA3.1(+) vector with an N-terminal Flag tag after an HA signal peptide.

literature_notes: L1 (structural studies construct with HA-SP + FLAG + 10×His + MBP + TEV + full-length B1R) corroborates the same N-terminal prepend site and was not dropped — it is a full-length membrane-anchored receptor, not a soluble ectodomain — but L2 is the stronger functional anchor and is used as the sole supporting_clip_id per schema rules. No internal extracellular loop site is supported by either ledger line; ECL1 (95–107), ECL2 (176–199), and ECL3 (273–288) have no published insertion evidence in the ledger. The intracellular C-terminus (316–353) is not a surface tag site.
